description_en: Retrieves the OSS resource configuration information that is used for subsequent OSS file upload operations
description_zh: 获取OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续OSS文件上传操作
name: GetOSSInfoForUploadFile

parameters.help_en:
The business type. Default value: fcMediaSms.

When you create a signature or template and upload additional materials, set this parameter to fcMediaSms
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，默认值为fcMediaSms。

创建签名、创建模板时，上传更多资料场景，该值为fcMediaSms
parameters.name: biz_type

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see Error codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.htm)
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见错误码列表 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.htm)

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

AccessKeyId.description_en: The AccessKey ID used for signing

Signature.description_en: The signature information calculated based on the AccessKey Secret and Policy. When you call an OSS API operation, OSS verifies this signature information to confirm the validity of the POST request
Signature.description_zh: 根据AccessKey Secret和Policy计算出的签名信息。调用OSS API时，OSS验证该签名信息，从而确认Post请求的合法性

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
